# Lending Policy: Default Risk and Collateral Review

This document outlines key review and monitoring activities related to lending operations:

*   Review of default risk on a quarterly basis.
*   Review of default risk based on audit findings.
*   Urgent updates to collateral value.
*   Investigation of interest rates based on audit findings.
*   Monitoring of standard collateral value updates.
